entrypoint: Existing product_measurements.py run_post_key_companions, after history and before Vault
scope: Normal index.js product UI with a development-only read-only native Realm observer; separate from r52_tls_probe transport entrypoint
preconditions: Exact private source, successful real hosted app build and startup, and unchanged installed native artifact
Existing disposable Testnet product account and one-wallet setup Retry fixture passed
Only product runner owns device, stopped-app Metro switching and Android reverse mappings
An older retained app additionally needs independently reviewed controller/app source and native-input equivalence; this same-source runner does not waive it
stages: baseline: neither fixture endpoint exists in native Realm
custom_saved: real AddNode CA paste, exact endpoint probe plus actual connection, saved ID and CA hash
failed_update_preserved: wrong-CA same-endpoint probe fails without a version RPC or saved-row change
cold_reopen: fresh app process, same persisted node ID and CA, actual new connection
disconnected: normal Server Settings disconnect updates the saved row and actual client
reconnected: normal Server Settings reconnect reaches the TLS fixture with unchanged saved trust
untrusted_peer_rejected: other-port endpoint under the first endpoint CA, without explicit CA, fails and creates no saved row
selfsigned_saved: explicit self-signed certificate through normal UI creates distinct endpoint trust and connects
fixture_nodes_removed: both disposable nodes removed by normal product UI
observer_reads: Current account-active boolean; real schema110 NodeConnect fixture rows only; public CA hashes; actual Electrum client connection and selected fixture port. No setters, mocks, account IDs, storage keys, credentials, wallet/address data or private CA keys.
proof: Each fixed Maestro checkpoint must match a fresh read-only app observation and independent loopback TLS/RPC connection witness. Host-only tests cannot establish any mobile result. JUnit, complete stage receipt, exact installed artifact, existing-account continuity and owned cleanup all required.
cleanup: Product UI removes own node rows; owned fixture TLS/HTTP sockets and key directory, generated public config, private UI output, and outer product runner reverse mappings/device/Metro
